questions.stem: A car travels around a circular track at a constant speed of 20 m/s. Which statement is true?

options.text: Both speed and velocity are changing
Velocity is constant but speed is changing
Speed is constant but velocity is changing
Both speed and velocity are constant

questions.explanation: Speed is a scalar (magnitude only) and remains at 20 m/s. However, velocity is a vector that includes direction. Since the car is constantly changing direction around the track, its velocity is constantly changing even though its speed is constant.
